purpose: Describe shots, speakers, faces, gestures and safe space without making editorial choices.
hard_gates: Unknown identity, low-confidence tracking and unavailable capabilities must remain explicit.
soft_gates: Tracks and safe regions should be stable enough to support camera and layout decisions.

failure.fallback: Declare the capability downgrade and use conservative static framing that never guesses identity.

regression_cases: Ambiguous face matching remains unknown rather than Krish.
Low-confidence gesture tracking cannot trigger a gesture-led crop.
